headline: Board heard updates on Millyard redevelopment, Nimco/Bagshaw project, Elm & High Street garage repairs, and Elm Street Middle School redevelopment.
summary: The Board of Aldermen received presentations on building development projects in the city, including the Millyard area, Nimco/Bagshaw redevelopment, BIDA parcels, the Elm Street and High Street garage repairs, and next steps for the Elm Street Middle School redevelopment project. No votes were taken on these matters; the meeting ended with a roll call vote to adjourn.
plain_text:
A Special Meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, September 22, 2026, at 6:45 pm in the Aldermanic 
Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91 -
A:2 II. 
   
Vice-President Ben Clemons presided; City Clerk Daniel Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Daniel Healey; Alderman Patricia Klee, led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 11members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, 
Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Dowd, Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly 
(via Zoom), Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, and Alderman Clemons.    
 
Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Gregg, Alderman Sennott, and Alderman Wilshire were recorded absent. 
 
Mayor Jim Donchess (arrived at 7:16) and Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton were also in attendance. 
 
DISCUSSIONS AND/OR PRESENTATIONS 
• Updated on Building Development in the City 
Vice-President Clemons recognized Administrative Services Director Tim Cummings, Community 
Development Director Matt Sullivan, and Economic Development Director Liz Hannum . 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN KLEE THAT THE SEPTEMBER 22, 2026 SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF 
ALDERMEN BE ADJOURNED BY ROLL CALL 
 
A viva voce roll call was taken, which resulted as follows: 
 
Yea: Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault,  
 Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Dowd, Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Johnson,  
 Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Morgan, Alderman Clemons        11  
 
Nay:                       0 
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 7:22 p.m.
